sources.title: Visitors

sources.title: Visa requirements for traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's currently linked Embassy schedule identifies itself as updated April 2024, names Zimbabwe, and defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained before travel.

sources.title: Immigration and visas

sources.title: Suspension of visa issuance to foreign nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The current State Department notice, last updated 2 February 2026, implements Proclamation 10998 and expressly includes Zimbabwe in the partial suspension of B-1/B-2 visitor visa issuance and entry effective 1 January 2026.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101: Definitions
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official current U.S. Code compilation defines United States geographically in the INA to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands and CNMI.
sources.supportingExcerpt: means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands ... and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

policies.title: Grenada: Zimbabwean ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule assigns Zimbabwean visitors to Prior to Arrival, defined as mission or consular visa issuance before travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Zimbabwean passport for short visitor travel.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment are outside this classification.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Panama: Zimbabwean ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule expressly requires Zimbabwean visitors to obtain a stamped visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Zimbabwean passport for short visitor travel.
File the stated visitor documents and, if approved, attend the consulate to have the visa stamped in the passport before travel.
The separate waiver for a qualifying third-country visa or residence document is conditional and is not used for this passport-only baseline.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official, transit, invitation-based and final-admission rules remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The current B-1/B-2 entry and visa-issuance suspension retains valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case waivers, so it cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The partial suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition of United States includes Puerto Rico. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The partial suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition of United States includes Guam. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The partial suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition of United States includes CNMI. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.

The partial suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition of United States includes the U.S. Virgin Islands. Its exceptions cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
